problem: Microsoft wanted to strengthen its developer ecosystem.
title: Microsoft acquires GitHub for $7.5 billion and promises independence
context: GitHub was the main host for open source code, and Microsoft had a history of conflict with the open source community.
decision_made: Acquire GitHub for $7.5 billion in Microsoft stock.
action_taken: Promised GitHub would keep a developer-first approach, operate independently and remain open; a Microsoft vice president became GitHub's CEO.
observed_outcome: Not documented in the sources used.
lessons: Acquirers with a sceptical audience often pair a deal with public commitments to independence.
limitations: Only the announcement and early commentary were checked. Whether the commitments were kept was not.

claims.claim_text: Microsoft agreed to buy GitHub for $7.5 billion in stock.
Coverage noted Microsoft's contentious history with the open source community.
